<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                   xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                   id="Definitions_Contract"
                   targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Inquiry" name="Request for offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartsBatch" name="Parts batch delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Complaint" name="Complaint mail"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Contractor" name="Contractor" processRef="Proc_Contractor"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_WebShop" name="Web shop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Friends" name="Friends"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Inquiry" name="Request offers" sourceRef="Task_RequestOffers" targetRef="Part_WebShop" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Part_WebShop" targetRef="Catch_OffersReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSingle" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderSingleShop" targetRef="Part_WebShop" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSeveral" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Part_WebShop" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Part_WebShop" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Part_WebShop" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PartsBatch" name="Parts batch" sourceRef="Part_WebShop" targetRef="Catch_PartsBatch" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Complaint" name="Complaint mail" sourceRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail" targetRef="Part_Friends" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Proc_Contractor" name="Contractor parts procurement" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Project" name="Contract project started"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestOffers" name="Request offers from web shops" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OffersReceived" name="Offers received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OffersReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CompareOffers" name="Compare quantity, price and delivery time of offers"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of parts per shop (cheapest parts)"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShopSplit" name="Single shop has enough parts?" default="SF_ShopMulti"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderSingleShop" name="Order all parts from one shop" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderSeveralShops" name="Order parts from several shops" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShopJoin" name="Orders placed"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitBatchMerge" name="Waiting for parts"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsBatch" name="Parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsBatch" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordParts" name="Record received parts in stock"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FirstBatch" name="First batch received?" default="SF_NotFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FirstBatchJoin" name="Batch checked"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Stock level of a part?" default="SF_StockSufficient"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_WriteComplaintMail" name="Write complaint mail to friends about web shops" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts from fastest shop (stock below 3)" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts (stock below 5)" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockJoin" name="Stock checked"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompleteSplit" name="All ordered parts received?" default="SF_NotComplete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartsComplete" name="All ordered parts received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Project" targetRef="Task_RequestOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RequestToOffers" sourceRef="Task_RequestOffers" targetRef="Catch_OffersReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OffersToCompare" sourceRef="Catch_OffersReceived" targetRef="UserTask_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CompareToList" sourceRef="UserTask_CompareOffers" targetRef="UserTask_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ListToShopSplit" sourceRef="UserTask_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Gateway_ShopSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ShopSingle" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderSingleShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${singleShopHasAllParts}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ShopMulti" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_SingleToJoin" sourceRef="Task_OrderSingleShop" targetRef="Gateway_ShopJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_SeveralToJoin" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_ShopJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_JoinToWait" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopJoin" targetRef="Gateway_WaitBatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_WaitToBatch" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitBatchMerge" targetRef="Catch_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BatchToRecord" sourceRef="Catch_PartsBatch" targetRef="Task_RecordParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RecordToFirst" sourceRef="Task_RecordParts" targetRef="Gateway_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_FirstYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstBatch" targetRef="UserTask_StartBuilding">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${firstBatchReceived}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotFirstBatch" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstBatch" targetRef="Gateway_FirstBatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StartBuildingToJoin" sourceRef="UserTask_StartBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_FirstBatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_FirstJoinToStock" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstBatchJoin" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StockZero" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StockBelow3" name="Stock above 0 and below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock > 0 && stock < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StockBelow5" name="Stock from 3 to below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock >= 3 && stock < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StockSufficient" name="Stock sufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_MailToStockJoin" sourceRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail" targetRef="Gateway_StockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_FastestToStockJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CheapestToStockJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StockJoinToComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_StockJoin" targetRef="Gateway_CompleteSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Complete" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompleteSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_PartsComplete">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allOrderedPartsReceived}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotComplete" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompleteSplit" targetRef="Gateway_WaitBatchMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
